drum_performances.name: Steve Gadd
drum_performances.why_it_matters: A landmark of studio drumming: highly interactive playing behind Wayne Shorter's sax solo, then an extended drum feature over the ensemble vamp near the end.

section_map.drum_approach: Extended drum feature over ensemble figures.

notable_moments.description: Widely reported to have been played largely from the chart in very few takes.
Solo built from rudimental language and tom melodies, developing over the vamp.
